subject: RE: FOI "Llandough Roman villa & medieval house finds were destroyed in a 1983 fire"
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Daer Requester,

Thank you for your enquiry.


  1.  The full HER for this reference is available on Archwilio. Please note that we are unable to include the related journal article for copyright reasons, however you may be able to purchase a copy from the publisher.



  1.  We have disabled links on Archwilio while we resolve security concerns related to the global PHP software issue .We hope to be able to reinstate the link as soon as practicable.


  1.  This information is not held in the HER.

Best regards

On behalf of Heneb

-----Original Message-----
From: Requester <[email redacted]<[email redacted]>>
Sent: 02 November 2026 18:12
To: HER <[email redacted]<[email redacted]>>
Subject: RE: FOI "Llandough Roman villa & medieval house finds were destroyed in a 1983 fire"

Dear HER Team,

Thank you for your reply of 2 November 2026 inviting requests for specific paper HER records. I would like to review the following:

1. The full HER file for PRN 02038s (Great House Farm, Llandough), including every source document behind the record.

2. In particular, the three documents attached to that record on Archwilio as 02038s_70255.pdf, 02038s_70256.pdf and 02038s_70257.pdf (an RCAHMW / NMR record card for Great House Farm, a copy of Suggett 1988; the South Glamorgan SMR record card for site 2038; and the South Wales Echo of 11 February 1989, "Battle of the rubble"). These downloaded from Archwilio on 24 October 2026. Each link now returns a "No such file" error.

3. Any consultation correspondence between GGAT and the planning authority (South Glamorgan County Council or the Vale of Glamorgan
Council) about Great House Farm, or about development at Church View Close, Llandough, between 1983 and 1989, with any GGAT site visit notes or photographs from that period.

Could you also:

4. Restore the three files on Archwilio, or tell me when and why they were removed; and

5. Tell me how I can view, or receive copies of, items 1 to 3 (by email if possible).


Kind regards,

Requester 
Royal Signals Cyber/ Electronic Warfare Professional bucklerfamily.estate

PS – For your records search, this property and area appear under several names and references. Please check under all of them:
Vale of Glamorgan; Glamorgan; South Glamorgan; Urban District of Penarth; CF64; [postcode redacted]; ST 167 733; ST 168 733; ST 1681 7331; Llandough-juxta-Penarth; Landoche-juxta-Cardif; Llandough near Penarth; Llandough near Cardiff; "Llandough, Penarth"; "Llandough, Cardiff"; Llandough; Llandochau; Llandough / Leckwith; "Penarth Road, Llandough"; Parish of Llandough; Great House Farm; "Great House Farm, Llandough"; Great House; "Great House, Llandough"; Tŷ Mawr; Ty Mawr / Tymawr; Tŷ Mawr Farm; Ty Mawr Farm; Llandough Home Farm; Llandough Farm; Cedfin; Cydfin; Cydfin Farm; Red Fen (Cedfin); Williams of Great House; Church View Close; St Dochdwy's Church; Farmhouse; "House, buildings, garden and yard"; Dwelling adjoining the churchyard; Rear wing; Eastern fields / agricultural holding; Woodland / Leckwith Woods.
Records may also be filed simply under "Great House" or "Llandough".
